text:
anya: Quick check — evening tacticals for the GPU buildout. What's the single biggest blocker for the next 48h? pinging infra/runtime/procurement
micah: Procurement: last-mile customs hold on 4 chassis. ETA updated to 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Other racks cleared today. Trying to confirm carrier cutover window.
jordan: Staging cluster: 2/6 nodes failing agent startup after image burn. I pushed a debug image to `staging-image:gpu-2026-03-16` and added logs in /var/log/agent.log.
leo: @jordan can you paste the failing unit logs? I can run the smoke script tonight.
jordan: here: ```
Mar 16 21:03:12 host-12 agent[1]: ERROR kvcache init failed: missing /dev/nvme1n1
Mar 16 21:03:12 host-12 agent[1]: FATAL: pinned mount not found
```
micah: NVMe mapping mismatch — looks like the burn process dropped the second device on those hosts. Ops flagged it as an image builder bug. Moving 2 hosts back to imgbuild queue.
procurement-bot: Shipment update: AWS Freight #AWF-9923 delayed 48h due to customs docs. New ETA 2026-03-19 18:00 PT. Tracking: https://carrier.example/awb/AWF-9923
sre-bot: Note: cluster smoke tests will be blocked while 2 nodes are cycled. Auto rollback policy will hold canary traffic.
karen: For Dedicated reservations: Finance approved shifting 4 reserved slots from next sprint to this sprint if we can hit acceptance by end of week. Need confirmation on burn success and power tests.
leo: Power tests scheduled tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT for rack A4 and A5. Ops on-call will run PDUs + breaker trip tests.
anya: Action items: (1) @jordan continue debug on burned image and requeue hosts if needed; (2) @micah confirm carrier window + escalate customs docs; (3) @leo run power tests and post smoke outputs; (4) @karen reconcile reservation shift with finance if burn passes. I'll follow up EOD with a short status. :thumbsup: 
micah: Will escalate customs ops now, cc legal for docs.
leo: I'll post power test snippets and a pass/fail line here after tests.
karen: I'll hold the reservation shift pending the pass message. Thanks everyone.
